name: Wanting To Get Married
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divine provision to address human loneliness, as God declared it is not good for man to be alone and provided a suitable helper for him. The union of husband and wife is designed to be a lasting, intimate bond where two become one flesh. Finding a wife is portrayed as a blessing and favor from the Lord, emphasizing the value of a prudent and virtuous woman. Above all, believers are encouraged to seek God’s kingdom first, trusting that He will provide what is needed, including the blessing of marriage.
